academicYears.title: Academic years
academicYears.intro: The school's academic years: the one being prepared, the one under way and those already closed.
academicYears.caption: Academic years of the school

empty.title: There are no academic years yet
empty.text: Create the first academic year to get started.

form.codeHint: Free text, unique in the school, for example 2026-2027.

notEditable.title: This academic year can no longer be edited
notEditable.text: An academic year can only be edited while it is in planning.

form.planningExists: There is already an academic year in planning: {code}.
form.openPlanning: Open the academic year in planning ({code})

detail.title: Academic year
detail.readOnly: Academic year {status}: its data is read-only.
detail.closureTitle: The academic year cannot be closed yet:
detail.noActions: This academic year admits no further actions.
detail.reopenTitle: The academic year cannot be reopened yet:

activate.title: Activate academic year {code}
activate.description: The academic year will become the school's active academic year.
activate.descriptionEnded: The end date of this academic year has already passed. It will still become the school's active academic year.

close.title: Close academic year {code}
close.description: Closing blocks writing: from now on the data of this academic year is read-only in all modules of the school. It can only be undone while no other academic year has been activated, by someone with the reopening permission and recording the reason; once the next academic year is activated, it can no longer be reopened.

errors.unexpected: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.

reopen.title: Reopen academic year {code}
reopen.description: Reopen an academic year that was closed by mistake. It will become the school's active academic year again.
reopen.warningWritable: All the data of the academic year will accept writing again in all modules.
reopen.warningNotCorrection: Reopening is not meant to correct a specific piece of data: it reopens the whole academic year.
reopen.warningReason: The reason is recorded. Do not include personal data in the reason.
